about: Every source gaba_excites takes a number, an equation or a method from, and what it took. The single source of truth: lit/README.md, lit/references.bib and public/lit.html are rendered from this file by `node scripts/lit.ts`, and src/lit.test.ts fails if they drift.

sources.title: Minimal Hodgkin–Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons
sources.took: The regular-spiking pyramidal cell: its currents (Traub INa and IKd, slow IM) and the published cell they make.

sources.title: ModelDB 123623: minimal Hodgkin–Huxley models of cortical and thalamic neurons (NEURON code for Pospischil et al. 2008)
sources.took: Every pyramidal-cell parameter, from sPY_template, HH_traub.mod and IM_cortex.mod — and the mechanisms themselves, run in NEURON as the oracle the port is tested against.

sources.title: Mechanisms underlying the synchronizing action of corticothalamic feedback through inhibition of thalamic relay cells
sources.access: free to read at the publisher
sources.took: Nothing directly: the thalamocortical model the RS cell was taken from, credited as the ModelDB code credits it.

sources.title: Neuronal Networks of the Hippocampus
sources.took: The origin of the Na⁺ and K⁺ kinetics (the "Traub" in hh2's vtraub).

sources.title: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) neuron excitability is regulated by estradiol feedback and kisspeptin
sources.took: The GnRH neuron: Equations 1–24, Tables 1–3 (negative-feedback parameter set), Cm = 20 pF and I_app = −6 pA, and the two published numbers the port is checked against — rest at −70 mV and the Fig. 7F spike counts.

quotes.text: I app is the applied current, which was set to −6 pA to hold the cell at −70 mV.
cells were injected with current from 0 to 30 pA (500 ms, 2 pA steps)

sources.title: A unified model for two modes of bursting in GnRH neurons
sources.took: The GnRH model Adams et al. 2018 modified; parameters marked "reestimated from Moran et al." in their Tables 2–3 come from here. Not read directly for any number in this app.

sources.title: Modeling of membrane excitability in gonadotropin-releasing hormone-secreting hypothalamic neurons regulated by Ca2+-mobilizing and adenylyl cyclase-coupled receptors
sources.took: The original Hodgkin–Huxley GnRH model that Moran et al. 2016 built on. Not read directly for any number in this app.

sources.title: Activation of A-type γ-aminobutyric acid receptors excites gonadotropin-releasing hormone neurons
sources.access: free to read at the publisher
sources.took: The GnRH cell's default E_GABA, −36.5 mV: measured by gramicidin perforated patch, which leaves intracellular chloride undisturbed.

quotes.text: E GABA measured 100 msec after GABA application was −36.5 ± 1.2 mV (n = 16 cells from 13 adult diestrous females).
quotes.where: Results; read from the publisher's full text, 2026-09-21

sources.title: The NEURON simulation environment
sources.took: The simulator used as the oracle (NEURON 9.0.2), and the integration scheme copied from it: backward Euler for V, then gates at the new V.

sources.title: A practical algorithm for solving dynamic membrane equations
sources.took: The exact exponential update of each gate at fixed voltage ("Rush–Larsen").

sources.title: On the theory of the Brownian motion
sources.took: The Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process behind the membrane-noise current.

sources.title: Fitting and statistical analysis of single-channel records
sources.booktitle: Single-Channel Recording, 2nd ed. (Sakmann B, Neher E, eds.)
sources.took: The Gaussian filter's σ = 0.1325 / fc, used to band-limit the recording noise.

sources.title: Changes in both neuron intrinsic properties and neurotransmission are needed to drive the increase in GnRH neuron firing rate during estradiol-positive feedback
sources.took: Nothing yet. Drives model GnRH neurons with recorded GABAergic conductance trains — the natural next GnRH preset.

sources.title: Response of gonadotropin-releasing hormone neurons from female mice to dynamic-clamp-simulated GABAergic conductances across development and after prenatal androgenization
sources.took: Nothing yet. Dynamic-clamp GABA conductances of 1–10 nS with 7 or 10 ms decay in GnRH neurons — a source for realistic GnRH GABA presets.

sources.title: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) neuron potassium currents and excitability in both sexes exhibit minimal changes upon removal of negative feedback
sources.took: Not used in the app. The slowly inactivating K⁺ current's inactivation (V½ ≈ −30 mV, slope ≈ 4.7, τ of seconds to tens of seconds) was added to the GnRH model's I_K in an experiment, to ask what it would do: at the published V½, nothing measurable.

quotes.text: full inactivation and recovery required >10s at +50 and −100 mV, respectively.
quotes.where: Materials and Methods, Voltage-gated potassium current characterization

quotes.text: Because inactivation was incomplete even after 51.29 s at −30 mV, this remaining current was not subtracted and the inactivation graphs level off at ∼30%.
quotes.where: Materials and Methods, Activation and inactivation of the slow current
